messages:
maria: heads up — some users on edge runtimes are getting "Cannot find module '../node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.cjs'" after installing the latest publish. seems like only .mjs shipped?
alex: ugh, can you paste the install + runtime error stack?
maria: sure — minimal stack:
```
Error: Cannot find module '/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.cjs'
    at Module._resolveFilename (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)    
    at Function.Module._resolveFilename (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
```
martin: this smells like a publish / files field mismatch. package.json main/exports probably point at .cjs but rollup/tsc emitted .mjs (or vice versa).
jen: also check if .map files were excluded — sourcemap paths in the .mjs can reference .map files that weren't published which confuses some edge bundlers.
build-bot: publish@ci: running `npm publish` (package/@redwood/sdk@0.12.3)
build-bot: files included: ["dist/index.mjs","dist/index.d.ts","README.md","LICENSE"]
maria: ^ that's the problem — package.json "main" is "dist/index.cjs" but dist only has index.mjs. edge runtimes try cjs fallback and crash.
alex: how did that happen? ci uses rollup + tsup? which step sets file extensions?
martin: tsup defaults to .mjs when target is ESM. older build config expected .cjs. we recently changed output.format to 'esm' but forgot to update package.json/exports. classic.
jen: quick notes:
- if you use conditional exports, make sure both "require" and "import" targets exist or map correctly.
- ensure "types" points to dist/index.d.ts (was missing in the publish?)
oliver: can confirm types are published, but sourcemap .map is missing — we have a comment in index.mjs: `//# sourceMappingURL=index.js.map` but `index.js.map` wasn't included in files.
maria: looks like .npmignore and package.json.files were overly strict. package.json.files had "dist/*.mjs" and "dist/*.d.ts" but not "dist/*.map" or "dist/*.cjs". we also used pnpm pack in CI, which respects package.json.files slightly differently than local tarball.
alex: immediate mitigation: republish a patch that either:
1) updates package.json "main" to point to dist/index.mjs and fixes exports mappings, or
2) add a dist/index.cjs build output alongside .mjs
oliver: (prefer 1) — fewer churn. edge runtimes that expect cjs should use conditional exports to map require->cjs, import->mjs. but if we don't want to build cjs, change main/exports accordingly and add an entry in README about ESM-only.
martin: i'll open a tiny PR to update package.json exports + files and add a ci check. suggestion for the check: run `npm pack --dry-run --json` in CI and assert expected files exist (index.mjs, index.d.ts, index.js.map). prevents this silently happening again.
jen: also add a smoke test in the sample-edge-app that does `import sdk from '@redwood/sdk'` in an edge-like env — will catch runtime resolution issues.
maria: i'll draft the PR and bump patch release. can someone do the quick republish? i'm OOO after 30m.
alex: i'll take the republish after CI green. small checklist in PR:
- fix package.json exports/main
- include .map files in package.files
- update README about ESM/CJS
- add npm-pack dry-run CI step
- update changelog with breaking note (if we remove CJS)
jen: also add a tiny test verifying `node --input-type=module -e "import('@redwood/sdk').then(console.log)"` works in CI.
maria: thanks team :thumbsup: i'll create the issue linking to this thread and assign tasks. opening now.
martin: FYI i'll also audit other packages in monorepo for the same files pattern, probably a few more libs have `files` missing maps.
oliver: +1. found at least one other package earlier. will add to audit ticket.
maria: created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432 — patch includes export fix, adds maps to package.files, and a simple npm-pack CI assertion. tagging @alex for publish.
alex: got it — will wait for green and publish 0.12.4, then ping support to notify impacted customers.
maria: thanks all — follow-up: add a short doc in devex about publish checklists (cjs/mjs/types/maps) so we don't forget. "publish checklist" would be a nice living doc.
jen: love it. also add a one-liner in release notes: "fixed missing dist files / mismatched main/exports".
build-bot: CI: run passed for PR #432
alex: republished as 0.12.4. sending note to #support and updating release notes.
maria: confirmed downstream sample-edge-app works after updating to 0.12.4. closing thread.
